newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Conglomerate pushes up Mauritius share index.
newsitem.headline: Conglomerate pushes up Mauritius share index.

text.p: An increase in the share price of conglomerate Rogers pushed the Mauritius bourse share index SEMDEX up by 1.04 points to 326.60 on Wednesday, brokers said.
Volume totalled 8.12 million rupees on 231,170 shares on Wednesday from 3.48 million rupees on 212,312 shares on Monday.

"Although several other shares gained ground on Wednesday, the price rise of Rogers was the predominant factor in the gain of the SEMDEX because of its strong weight in the index," a broker said. Rogers rose one rupee to 92.50 on 8,324 shares.
"On the whole, the market had a better performance as compared to trading during the past few weeks," the broker said.

"Probably investors are settling down with the idea that a full cabinet is now operational," he added. The SEMDEX hit consecutive year lows in September and October in the absence of a finance minister.

Conglomerate Ireland Blyth gained 20 cents to 12.60 rupees on 4,249 shares despite reporting a slump in profit for the nine months period ending 30 September 1996. A broker said results were too late to affect the market.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 54,788 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.90 rupees on 26,700 shares.
Mauritius Chemical Industries eased 10 cents to 10.20 rupees on 460 shares. In the investment sector, Promotion And Development (PAD) gained 40 cents to 14.60 rupees on 1,200 shares.
Sugar-stock Mon Tresor Mon Desert was up 30 cents to 38 rupees on 2,207 shares. Happy World Foods gained 20 cents to 16 rupees on 14,447 shares.
Hotel concern Sun Resorts was 30 cents higher to 35.20 rupees on 500 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 29.20 rupees on 77,050 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 50 rupees on 1,100 shares.
